operation.name: savetif8
operation.description:
Same command as SAVETIF but the output file is saved in 8-bit per channel: filename .tif. The option -astro allows saving in Astro-TIFF format, while -deflate enables compression

Links: savetif

Uses fixed input references and writes only invocation-owned outputs. Optional argument values are sent only when their use_* control is true; zero is preserved.

help:
Siril 1.4.4. Same command as SAVETIF but the output file is saved in 8-bit per channel: filename .tif. The option -astro allows saving in Astro-TIFF format, while -deflate enables compression

Links: savetif

Uses fixed input references and writes only invocation-owned outputs. Optional argument values are sent only when their use_* control is true; zero is preserved.



runtime is a JSON object. Supported keys: ini, settings, threads, memory_ratio, output_bits, compression, online, selection, findstar, photometry. Networking starts offline and must be enabled explicitly. Selection is omitted for the whole image or explicitly null to clear it; optional CLI arguments use separate use_* controls. Automatic complete-result calculation can target explicitly opted-in processing and analysis operations without an export node. Manual execution retains explicit export, stacking, or analysis endpoints. Only requested dependencies are executed. Saved output references identify complete checked files, never preview pixels. See reference/coverage.json and docs/usage.md.
